correctness.rationale: For the sign pair, put t_i=x_i y_i. The rank-one projector gives the error −a_i t_i Σ_{l≠i}a_l²t_l/T in either order. The t_i are independent signs, so a covariance term survives exactly for l=m on the diagonal or the crossed pair (l,m)=(j,i) off it. Summing the diagonal yields the claimed risk; with w_i=a_i²/T, its normalized value is the w_i-weighted average of w_i(1−w_i). Equality forces both positive weights to be 1/2. For Gaussian probes the endpoint ranks give exactness. In the middle phase, rotation invariance of the independent omitted sketch gives P_ii strictly between 0 and 1 almost surely, so the off-diagonal row of P has positive squared norm P_ii(1−P_ii). Its contraction with the other coordinates of the omitted probe has a nondegenerate Gaussian law conditional on P. When its i-th coordinate s tends to zero the other leave-one-out terms stay bounded: at zero their sketch contains one almost surely nonzero vector in the coordinate hyperplane and k−2 independent full Gaussians, hence is full column rank, and continuity holds nearby. Thus the pole cannot cancel and the conditional absolute moment diverges for p≥1. For p<1, subadditivity and the absolute moment of a Gaussian ratio suffice. For n=k=2 the Cauchy pair reduces the error to −aF/2 with F=UV[(1+U²)⁻¹+(1+V²)⁻¹]. On |U|≥|V| at fixed V=v the limiting one-signed coefficient is |v|/[π(1+v²)], and a constant multiple of this bounds the scaled tail uniformly by the Cauchy tail inequality. Integrating against the Cauchy density gives 1/π² per region, hence a/π² in each tail after scaling and sign symmetry.
residual_risks: Analytic verification, not a replay of the finite checks or a numerical-stability guarantee. Gaussian threshold applies to positive scalar matrices and literal coordinate division; the exact tail constants apply only to n=k=2.

value.rationale: The sharp sign example separates zero component disagreement from true risk, and even shows that moving from one probe to two need not improve this estimator. The Gaussian calculation identifies a real rank-dependent failure of a natural but formal probe-law substitution: nonintegrability persists for every intermediate count and disappears at full omitted-sketch rank. These can be used as exact estimator and diagnostic benchmarks without claims about software or performance outside the stated model.
residual_risks: No claim about published uncertainty diagnostics, arbitrary Gaussian diagonal estimation, finite precision, or nondiagnonal inputs.
